data.rationale: The proposal follows the true workflow's steps in the same order (search, open the restaurant, set date and guests, click Notify, set times and confirm) and covers all the true parameters, but it adds an optional city parameter and an "if unavailable" condition, and it splits search_query from restaurant without saying how the two relate, so an automation would need small clarifications.
